## Load Packages
```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(tidyverse)
```


## Read in the Data
```{r}
gardens <- read.csv("data/DenverGardens_Sites.csv")

tcc_path <- "data/"
imperv_path <- "data/"

# Load rasters into R
tcc_ras <- rast(tcc_path)  # Tree canopy cover raster
imperv_ras <- rast(imperv_path)
```

# Extract Raster Data

Extract City Coordinates
```{r}
# Extract city coordinates
garden_coords <- st_as_sf(gardens, coords = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = 4326) # Use EPSG 4326 for WGS84
```

Extract Raster CRS
```{r}
# Get the CRS of the rasters (assuming both rasters have the same CRS)
crs_rasters <- crs(tcc_ras)
```

Create buffers and function to extract summed buffer values
```{r}
# Create a buffer around sites
buffer_radius <- 1000  # set to desired buffer size (in meters)
garden_buffer <- st_transform(st_buffer(st_transform(garden_coords, crs_rasters), dist = buffer_radius), crs_rasters)

# Function to extract summed raster values for buffers
extract_raster_sum <- function(raster, buffers) {
  extracted_values <- terra::extract(raster, as(buffers, "SpatVector"), fun = sum, na.rm = TRUE)
  extracted_values[, 2]  # Assuming the summed values are in the second column
}
```

Extract summed tree canopy cover and impervious surface values from each garden
```{r}
# Extract summed values for the 45 km buffer from both rasters
gardens$tcc1km <- extract_raster_sum(tcc_ras, garden_buffer)
gardens$imp1km <- extract_raster_sum(imperv_ras, garden_buffer)

# View the final dataframe
print(gardens)
```

### Project cities points onto rasters
```{r}
plot(tcc_ras,
     main = "Tree Canopy Cover")
plot(garden_coords$geometry,
     pch = 19)
```

```{r}
plot(imperv_ras,
     main = "Impervious Surface")
plot(garden_coords$geometry)
```
